Job Description 
 • Strong core java fundamentals, along with service development experience in Spring or similar frameworks. 
 •Candidates must be open to learn and work in new technologies and programming languages such as Kafka and Go Lang. 
 •Work will involve writing Java code, and also learning and applying various other open source technologies in the Apache stack. 
 • Candidate should be local to Dallas area for a face to face interview. 


 All your information will be kept confidential according to EEO guidelines.
